name: Sertraline
description: A selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor approved for major depressive disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder, panic disorder, PTSD, social anxiety disorder and premenstrual dysphoric disorder. Carries a boxed warning for suicidality in young people.

systems.note: Serotonin reuptake inhibition; the labelled indications.
Hyponatraemia from SIADH is labelled for the SSRI class.
Transaminase elevation and rare hepatic injury are documented.
Impaired platelet aggregation and bleeding risk are labelled.
Sexual dysfunction is a labelled and common class effect.

monitors.why: Documented transaminase elevation and rare hepatic injury.
Boxed suicidality warning; the labelled monitoring obligation.
